name: spi_target
description: SPI target, mode 0, no chip select: in0 is SCLK (uio5), in1 is MOSI (uio6), out2 is MISO (uo[0] while the host opcode is 7). The core's coded shifter presents the reply's MSB when SHIFT starts it, samples MOSI on every SCLK rise and shifts the next reply bit out right after it; the lane supplies replies from the source stream and stores received bytes.
